why: An unbounded z.string() accepts a 16 MB value into the document and the $jsonSchema derived from it has no maxLength either. Every string carries .max().
good:
cwd: z.string().min(1).max(4096),
host: z.string().max(253),
hex: z.string().regex(HEX),
_id: z.string(),
session_id: z.string(),
facts: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()),
